post_text:
BWH Hotels, the parent of @Best Western Hotels & Resorts, renamed itself @WorldHotels on 27 October.

The change concerns the group, not its hotels: Best Western and SureStay keep their names. The group counts about 4,000 hotels, 18 brands and some 70 million loyalty members in more than 100 countries.

A single programme, WorldHotels Rewards, will replace Best Western Rewards on 5 January 2027, with three status tiers. Members keep their status and points.

WorldHotels was the independent collection the group bought in 2019. Under President and CEO @Larry Cuculic, its name now leads the whole portfolio.

The signal: groups now sell themselves to travellers through their most upmarket name. The loyalty programme, not the logo on the door, is what they really want to unify.

Should a group lead with its most upscale brand?
